# Token Counting Tools and APIs

Dimension 3 of the LLM Token Budgeting research. Covers provider-specific
tokenizers, cross-provider counting challenges, and estimation vs exact counting.
Source details in [citations.md](../citations.md).

## Provider-Specific Token Counting

| Provider | API/Library | Method | Rate Limits | Accuracy |
|----------|------------|--------|-------------|----------|
| Anthropic | `/v1/messages/count_tokens` | Server-side API | 100-8,000 RPM by tier [14] | Estimate; may include system tokens (not billed) [14] |
| OpenAI | tiktoken (client-side) | Local BPE encoding | N/A (local) | Estimate; 3 tokens/message + 3 reply overhead [15] |
| Google | `countTokens` API | Server-side API | 3,000 RPM [16] | Multimodal counts are estimates [16] |
| AWS Bedrock | `CountTokens` API | Server-side API | Per-model [26] | Model-specific [26] |

### Anthropic Claude

Endpoint: POST `/v1/messages/count_tokens`. Free to use. Supports system
prompts, tools, images, PDFs, and extended thinking. Thinking blocks from
previous assistant turns are ignored. ZDR eligible. Token counts may include
system-optimization tokens that are not billed [14].

### OpenAI tiktoken

Client-side BPE tokenizer. Three main encodings [15]:

| Encoding | Models |
|----------|--------|
| `o200k_base` | GPT-4o, GPT-4o-mini |
| `cl100k_base` | GPT-4, GPT-3.5-turbo |
| `p50k_base` | Codex models |

Chat message overhead: 3 tokens per message + 1 per name field + 3 reply
priming tokens. Function calling adds 7 tokens per function (GPT-4o) or 10
(GPT-3.5/4) [15].

### Google Gemini

1 token ≈ 4 characters, 100 tokens ≈ 60-80 English words [16].

Multimodal token rates [16]:
- Images ≤384px both dimensions: 258 tokens
- Larger images: 258 tokens per 768×768 tile
- Video: 263 tokens/second
- Audio: 32 tokens/second

`media_resolution` parameter in Gemini 3 provides granular control over
vision processing token allocation [16].

## Cross-Provider Libraries

| Library | Coverage | Features |
|---------|----------|----------|
| tokencost | 400+ models [31] | Client-side counting + cost estimation |
| SentencePiece | Llama, Mistral, many open models | ~50K sentences/sec; Python 3.9-3.14 |
| HuggingFace Transformers | Llama (byte-level BPE) | ByteFallback, no normalization |
| Langfuse | OpenAI, Anthropic, Google | Automatic via ingestion or inference [24] |

Langfuse includes built-in tokenizers: OpenAI (cl100k_base, o200k_base via
tiktoken), Anthropic (@anthropic-ai/tokenizer), Google (native). Note: Anthropic
tokenizer is "not accurate for Claude 3 models" — use API response tokens when
possible [24].

## Estimation vs Exact Counting

**The "1 token ≈ 4 characters" rule is only a rough estimate**, unsuitable for
precise cost calculation or context window management [16].

Factors that inflate token counts beyond estimation:
- URLs/file paths: 15+ tokens each
- JSON: ~2× tokens vs plain text
- Base64 encoded data: 10-50× more tokens than describing content
- Non-English text: significantly more tokens than English equivalents [15]
- Provider-added hidden tokens: roles, tools, metadata [14][15]

**Accuracy hierarchy** (most to least accurate):
1. Provider API response (`usage.prompt_tokens`) — ground truth for billing
2. Provider token counting API — pre-send estimate
3. Provider-specific client library (tiktoken) — good for same-provider
4. Cross-provider libraries — estimates with provider-dependent accuracy
5. Character-based heuristic (÷4) — rough planning only

## Reasoning Token Tracking

For reasoning models (OpenAI o-series, Claude extended thinking), reasoning
tokens require special handling:
- Claude: thinking blocks from previous turns are ignored in token counts;
  current turn thinking counts toward input [14]
- Langfuse: cost inference not supported for reasoning models (o1 family) [24]
- AG2/AutoGen: no documented support for reasoning token tracking [26]

## Gaps and Limitations

- No published benchmarks comparing cross-provider library accuracy vs
  provider-native APIs
- Hidden token overhead (system prompts, tool definitions, metadata) as a
  percentage of total cost is not well quantified
- Reasoning token budgeting best practices are emerging and not yet
  standardized
- Multimodal token counting remains estimation-only for images and video
  across all providers
